appLibrary.title: Application Library
appLibrary.subtitle: Launch integrated applications with seamless authentication

connected.title: Connected apps
connected.body: Each card shows what that app may access (for example profile and subscription). Choosing Launch App while you are signed in here opens the app and grants only those permissions—no second confirmation page. The Available pill is a quick check from your device to the app's URL; if it shows Offline, the app may be stopped, blocked, or the environment may prevent the test (for example some mixed-content or privacy settings).

changePlans.question: Can I change plans later?

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
